write_up: A recruiter sees a retail banker who progressed to managing a branch and grew its deposits. There's enough here to move forward, with one big question: what have you been doing since the Branch Manager role ended?

The deposit line is your model. It names the work, the starting and ending figures, and the period. Let's make the rest of the management story as concrete, starting with what the 11 employees did and your part in the branch audits.

cards.cannot_tell: A recruiter can't tell what you've been doing since the Branch Manager role ended. If you took care of a family member, name that; if you took a break, you can include what you did during it. Include freelance work only if it was real, and use the actual end date if the activity has ended.
cards.example: December 2024 - Present  [what you did: caregiving, a career break, study, travel, freelance work if real]
cards.question: What have you been doing since December 2024, and when did it start and end?
